description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the MembershipService component of the OrangeHRM system, verifying methods related to membership data such as listing, retrieving by ID, deleting, and searching by name.

classes.name: MembershipServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the MembershipService functionalities within the OrangeHRM's Admin Service layer.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including creating a new MembershipService instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of Membership objects, verifying the number of items and their type.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests data retrieval of a single Membership by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests the deletion of multiple Membership entries by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Membership object by its name.
